# Blues Company

> Freight forwarding information and shipment-planning tools from Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

## Official pages
- [Homepage](https://www.bluescompany.site/): freight services, carrier links, planning tools, and quote requests.
- [Truck Exchange](https://www.bluescompany.site/marketplace.html): signed-in marketplace for truck capacity and cargo requests.
- [Policies](https://www.bluescompany.site/policies.html): website terms, privacy, cookies, and payment/refund information.

## Important context
- Carrier tracking is provided by the linked shipping lines; this website does not provide live carrier data.
- Planning calculators and route suggestions are indicative and are not a booking, schedule, or delivery promise.
- Service availability, rates, cargo requirements, and payment terms must be confirmed in a written quote before booking.
- Marketplace members should independently verify operator identity, vehicle suitability, insurance, cargo, and payment terms.
